title: Interpret Sorter Zone Behavior: AGV Pickup/Drop-Off Restricted to Its Zone; Backfill Uses FIFO-like Logic
summary: Use the sorter-side zone rules to interpret observed AGV movement during exchange/backfill: an AGV operating in a zone only picks up and drops off within that zone, performs an in-zone exchange check, and backfill behaves FIFO-like with additional considerations such as zone closures.
when_to_use: When you are observing AGV movement and exchange/backfill behavior on the sorter side and need to interpret whether the behavior matches zone-constrained pickup/drop-off and FIFO-like backfill logic.
not_for: Do not use this as a troubleshooting procedure for specific RMS/WCS/SSMS faults or to diagnose system faults; the source does not provide named UI fields/controls or fault codes for zone behavior.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Observe AGV movement relative to sorter zones and interpret behavior using the zone pickup/drop-off constraint and FIFO-like backfill description.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual/operational observation of AGV movement relative to zone boundaries
Sorter zone layout reference (if available on-site)

system_preconditions: Sorter-side zone layout is known/available for reference so you can judge whether pickup/drop-off occurs within the same zone.

visual_references.description: Training frame containing the sorter-side zone behavior and FIFO-like backfill description (entrance queue / queue locations / sorter queue locations / exit queue / shutdown queues context plus zone algorithm summary).

steps.title: Identify the concept of “zones” on the sorter side (zone-based operating areas).
steps.purpose: Establish the operating-area boundary so you can interpret whether an AGV’s pickup/drop-off actions are consistent with zone constraints.
steps.instruction: Using the sorter zone layout reference (if available on-site), identify the zone boundary for the AGV you are observing.
steps.expected_result: You can map the observed AGV’s activity to a specific sorter zone (i.e., you know which zone it is operating within).
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV’s observed movement can be associated with a single zone operating area for the period you are interpreting.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot determine which zone the AGV is operating in (zone boundaries are unclear/unavailable), making it impossible to apply the zone pickup/drop-off rule.

actions.label: Confirm zone boundary reference
actions.exact_action: Visually reference the sorter zone layout to determine the AGV’s zone.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The other part of the sorter side you should know about is there’s zones… an AGV in a zone… only picks up and drops off in its zone.”

steps.title: Confirm the zone constraint: an AGV in a zone only picks up and drops off in its zone.
steps.purpose: Validate that the observed pickup/drop-off behavior matches the zone-based operating constraint.
steps.instruction: Observe the AGV’s pickup and drop-off actions and check that both occur within the same zone it is operating in.
steps.expected_result: Your interpretation matches the rule: the AGV only picks up and drops off within its zone.
steps.healthy_condition: Pickup and drop-off locations you observe are within the same zone boundary for that AGV.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV appears to pick up or drop off outside its zone boundary.

actions.label: Check pickup/drop-off zone match
actions.exact_action: Compare observed pickup/drop-off locations against the AGV’s zone boundary.

stop_or_escalate_if: If AGVs appear to pick up/drop off outside their zone, escalate for support rather than assuming normal behavior.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “an AGV in a zone… only picks up and drops off in its zone.”

steps.title: Observe the in-zone exchange/backfill behavior: come into its zone, check if anything needs to be exchanged, then move on.
steps.purpose: Interpret the sequence of actions as an in-zone exchange check rather than an out-of-zone behavior.
steps.instruction: Watch the AGV as it enters its zone: interpret its behavior as coming into the zone, checking whether anything needs to be exchanged, and then moving on.
steps.expected_result: You can describe the observed behavior as an in-zone exchange check followed by movement onward.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV’s behavior aligns with: enters zone → exchange check in zone → moves on.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV’s observed behavior does not include an in-zone exchange check as described (e.g., it moves through without the expected in-zone exchange behavior).

actions.label: Interpret exchange check sequence
actions.exact_action: Observe the AGV entering its zone and interpret whether it performs an exchange check in that zone before moving on.

stop_or_escalate_if: If exchange checks do not occur as described, escalate for support rather than assuming normal behavior.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “AGV… backfills, comes into its zone, sees if anything needs to be exchanged, moves on.”

steps.title: Interpret backfill ordering as FIFO-like with additional considerations (e.g., zone closures).
steps.purpose: Avoid misattributing backfill ordering to priority/time-based behavior when it is described as FIFO-like with zone-closure considerations.
steps.instruction: When interpreting which AGV/tote actions occur first during backfill, treat the ordering as FIFO-like, and account for additional considerations such as whether a zone is closed.
steps.expected_result: Your interpretation matches FIFO-like backfill behavior rather than priority/time-based exchange behavior.
steps.healthy_condition: Observed backfill ordering appears consistent with FIFO-like behavior, with deviations explainable by zone closure considerations.
steps.failure_condition: Observed backfill ordering appears inconsistent with FIFO-like behavior and cannot be explained by zone closure considerations.

actions.label: Apply FIFO-like interpretation
actions.exact_action: Interpret backfill ordering as FIFO-like, considering zone closure effects.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “the backfill has to think about it’s first and first style… if zone 6 is closed and zone 4… so it’s trying to… get that median exchange time… it’s basically FIFO.”

success_criteria: You can explain observed AGV movement as zone-constrained pickup/drop-off with an in-zone exchange check.
You can interpret backfill ordering as FIFO-like (not priority/time-based) with possible effects from zone closures.
healthy_conditions: AGV pickup and drop-off occur within the same zone boundary.
AGV behavior includes an in-zone exchange check before moving on.
Backfill ordering appears FIFO-like, with deviations explainable by zone closure considerations.
failure_conditions: AGVs appear to pick up/drop off outside their zone.
Exchange checks do not occur as described.
Backfill ordering appears inconsistent with FIFO-like logic without an explanation tied to zone closure considerations.
escalation_guidance: If AGVs appear to pick up/drop off outside their zone or exchange checks do not occur as described, escalate for support rather than assuming normal behavior.
